# Vendored Browser Assets

These browser assets are served locally so git-diff-preview works offline and
does not load CDN assets from the browser. Some assets are committed here, and
the generated bundles next to this directory are produced at build / pack time.

| Package | Version | Files | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| diff2html | 3.4.56 | `diff2html/diff2html.min.css`, `diff2html/diff2html-ui.min.js` | MIT, https://github.com/rtfpessoa/diff2html |
| highlight.js styles | 11.9.0 | `highlight.js/LICENSE`, `highlight.js/styles/github*.min.css` | BSD-3-Clause, https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js |
| xterm.js styles | 6.0.0 | `xterm/LICENSE`, `xterm/xterm.css` | MIT, https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js |
| Browser bundle dependencies | fixed by `pnpm-lock.yaml` | generated `../app.js`, `../mermaid.js`, `../shiki.js`, `../xterm.js`, `highlight.js/highlight.min.js` | see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt` |

`diff2html-ui.min.js` is the UI bundle from the npm package. The
`highlight.js/styles/*.min.css` theme files and `highlight.js/LICENSE` are
committed manually; they only need to be refreshed when upgrading the
`highlight.js` version pinned in `package.json`. `xterm/xterm.css` and
`xterm/LICENSE` are committed the same way and follow the `@xterm/xterm`
version pinned in `package.json`; the terminal drawer needs that stylesheet
before the lazily loaded `../xterm.js` bundle can render a pane.

`../app.js`, `../mermaid.js`, `../shiki.js`, `../xterm.js`, and
`highlight.js/highlight.min.js`
are generated by `pnpm run build:web` (the last one registers every language
bundled with `highlight.js`, not just its CDN "common" subset) and are
included in npm tarballs, but are not tracked in git.
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt` is generated from the installed npm packages during
the same build.
